plugins.name: claude-annotate
plugins.description: Read Claude's long answers in a browser and comment on any block; Claude rewrites that block in place. Also builds and reviews slide decks (/slides, /deck), draws a feature's data flow (/dataflow) and shows one Java object filled with real values (/specimen). Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH, and /annotate, /deck, /dataflow and /specimen also need the separately-installed webcompanion daemon (pipx install webcompanion && webcompanion install-service); run /annotate-doctor to check or install it. /slides does not use the daemon.

plugins.name: claude-ide-review
plugins.description: Ask Claude questions on a PR diff line or a code walkthrough step in IntelliJ, or open any local diff in VS Code and ask on its lines. Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH and either the companion IntelliJ plugin (/ask-diff, /walkthrough) or the vscode-plugin extension (/show-diff). /ask-diff and /walkthrough also need the separately-installed webcompanion daemon, as do /show-diff's per-line comments (run /annotate-doctor to check or install it); only /show-diff's read-only diff opens without it.
